I am not requesting towing or enforcement. I would like to know if the County can evaluate this location for a possible parking restriction or another safety improvement.

Thank you.

issues.description: This utility pole has been busted for a while. It’s been braced previously, to attempt to stabilize it. These braces are not supporting this pole. This is a serious safety hazard, it’s only a matter of time before this pole comes down and injuries someone. How can we get this addressed?

I would like to report an ongoing traffic safety issue at the entrance to the parking lot on Corporate Drive.

Vehicles traveling on Corporate Drive are making illegal left turns into the parking lot by crossing a lane that is designated only for vehicles traveling from New Design Road to merge right into the entrance. This entrance is not designed or signed for left turns from Corporate Drive.

Drivers are making these turns in a U-turn-like fashion, blocking the single travel lane and causing significant congestion for vehicles approaching from Crestwood. The backups create unnecessary delays and increase the risk of a rear-end or side-impact collision.

Would it be possible to install flexible delineator posts or similar barriers—like those used to separate bicycle lanes—to physically prevent vehicles from making these illegal left turns? A barrier would help keep traffic flowing properly, discourage illegal maneuvers, and improve safety before a serious crash occurs.

Thank you for considering this request.
